# PRB-004: Panels and dashboards are not reachable from the internet

- **Group:** Outside view
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Ports 3000 (Dokploy, Grafana), 6001 and 6002 (Coolify realtime and terminal), 8000 (Coolify), 8080 and 8081 (Traefik dashboard, admin UIs), 9000 (Portainer), 9090 (Prometheus) and 3100 (Loki) serve control panels and telemetry. A panel grants control of every app it manages, a fresh install may let the first visitor create the admin account, and metrics endpoints leak internal names and versions. Docker published ports bypass UFW, so only an outside probe shows whether the provider firewall closes them. This is the outside half of PAAS-003 and the answer NET-009 asks for.

## Verify by hand

```sh
for p in 3000 6001 6002 8000 8080 8081 9000 9090 3100; do nc -vz -w 3 <host> $p; done   # from another machine
```

## How to fix it

Bind panels and dashboards to 127.0.0.1 or the tailnet address and reach them over the tailnet or behind an access proxy; close the ports in the provider firewall.

## What a fix can break

Losing the only path to a panel locks you out of it; keep a tailnet path working before closing the public one.

Run `stackward explain PRB-004` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
